extra_quotes: The Fe/MCA/Pt multilayers were grown on GaAs(001) substrates by molecular beam epitaxy, as illustrated in Fig . 1(a).
Current-driven switching was measured using a pulsed current source (Keithley 6221) and a nanovoltmeter (Keithley 2182A).
Magnetization dynamics were simulated within a macrospin model by solving the Landau -Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation.
The pulse width was fixed at 50 μs due to instrumental limitations
Although logic operations are performed under field -free conditions , the programming step currently requires an external magnetic field, which may limit device scalability.
